meta.note: Two things live here. (1) The 'moon' COMPONENT — the Moon's sign dignity and its angular separation from the Sun. Paksha is deliberately NOT a third slot: it is already priced into mc_tithi.json, and counting it twice would double-penalise the waning fortnight. (2) Rows carrying their own "kind":"penalty" and "penalty_group":"graha" — the Jupiter/Venus heliacal-set bars. A rule-level kind overrides meta.kind.

translations.en: Moon exalted in Vrishabha (Rohini's sign) — maximum strength.
translations.hi: चन्द्र वृषभ में उच्च — परम बल।

rules.interpretation: The Moon is karaka of the mind, of the mother and of conception. Exalted, it gives the fullest support to this samskara.

translations.en: Moon in its own sign Karka — very strong.

rules.interpretation: Swakshetra placement; the Moon acts freely and beneficially.

translations.en: Moon in a friendly sign — comfortable and supportive.
Moon in a neutral sign — ordinary strength.
translations.hi: चन्द्र सम राशि में — सामान्य बल।

rules.interpretation: Neither helped nor hindered by the sign.

translations.en: Moon in an inimical sign — weakened.

rules.interpretation: The Moon is uncomfortable and its beneficence is reduced.

translations.en: Moon debilitated in Vrishchika — weakest sign placement.
translations.hi: चन्द्र वृश्चिक में नीच — न्यूनतम बल।

rules.interpretation: Neecha Chandra is specifically deprecated for muhurtas concerning the mind, the mother and conception.

translations.en: Moon within 12° of the Sun — kshina (spent) and effectively combust.
translations.hi: चन्द्र सूर्य से 12° के भीतर — क्षीण व अस्तप्राय।

rules.interpretation: A Moon this close to the Sun has almost no bala. This is the amavasya neighbourhood and is universally rejected.

translations.en: Moon 12°–30° from the Sun — still weak in light.
translations.hi: चन्द्र सूर्य से 12°–30° — प्रकाश में दुर्बल।

rules.interpretation: Emerging from or approaching combustion; usable only with strong support elsewhere.

translations.en: Moon 30°–72° from the Sun — moderate strength.
Moon 72°–120° from the Sun — strong and well lit.
translations.hi: चन्द्र सूर्य से 72°–120° — बलवान व प्रकाशयुक्त।

rules.interpretation: The Moon holds ample light and independent strength.

translations.en: Moon more than 120° from the Sun — maximum luminous strength.
translations.hi: चन्द्र सूर्य से 120° से अधिक — परम प्रकाश-बल।

rules.interpretation: Full paksha bala. Note that the tithi table separately handles Purnima itself, which is barred on Parva grounds despite this strength.

translations.en: Guru Asta — Jupiter is combust (within 11° of the Sun); samskaras are suspended.
translations.hi: गुरु अस्त — बृहस्पति सूर्य से 11° के भीतर; संस्कार स्थगित।

rules.interpretation: Jupiter is the karaka of progeny and of dharmic sanction. While he is heliacally set he cannot bless the rite, and the classical texts suspend marriage, upanayana and garbhadhana for the whole period. The 11° orb is stated here as data, not in code, so it can be adjusted per tradition.

translations.en: Shukra Asta — Venus (direct) is combust within 10° of the Sun; samskaras are suspended.
translations.hi: शुक्र अस्त — शुक्र (मार्गी) सूर्य से 10° के भीतर; संस्कार स्थगित।

rules.interpretation: Venus governs shukra dhatu and conjugal life. His heliacal setting bars the same rites as Guru Asta. Orb for a direct Venus is wider than for a retrograde one.

translations.en: Shukra Asta — retrograde Venus combust within 8° of the Sun; samskaras are suspended.
translations.hi: शुक्र अस्त — वक्री शुक्र सूर्य से 8° के भीतर; संस्कार स्थगित।

rules.interpretation: A retrograde planet is nearer the Earth and sets at a narrower elongation, so the orb is 8° rather than 10°.

translations.en: Moon both debilitated and near the Sun — a compounded weakness.
translations.hi: चन्द्र नीच एवं सूर्य के निकट — द्विगुण दुर्बलता।

rules.interpretation: Fires only when the two weaknesses coincide; the individual states are already priced in the moon component, so this is a small additional penalty for the combination.
